verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a CLI and background/async agents that run outside the UI (in terminal, Slack, GitHub), suggesting some non-UI access paths, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive API that mirrors full UI functionality (e.g. all editing, review, rules/plugins management, MCP configuration) programmatically. Missing for 10: documented public API reference, explicit API parity claims, evidence that UI-only features (rules, marketplace, plan mode, enterprise MCP admin) are API-accessible.
